answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 71 epochs of grading, and every lagoon settlement recomputes the island schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 71 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
